page.content:
The People's Champion — third-generation star who crossed into Hollywood.

How The Rock connects

  • Character: Stone Cold Steve Austin — Austin and The Rock's rivalry capped the Attitude Era at WrestleMania.
  • Topic: WWE — The Rock became WWE's most exported crossover star.

What is The Rock?

Dwayne Johnson, The Rock, rose through The Nation and a corporate-champion heel turn into WWE's most exported star, with catchphrase promos and main events opposite Austin, Hogan, and Cena.

Key threads lead to Stone Cold Steve Austin and WWE.
